title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.

title: Hudugaru
desc: Prabhu, Chandru and Siddesh aspire to have a government job and try to lead a simple lifestyle. But their lives change dramatically when they attempt to unite two lovers.

title: Sye
desc: Chakri, who dreams to become a police officer, falls for a woman named Kannika. But things change when Mosale, a corrupt policeman, provokes him to fight.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.
